mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document regarded as a common standard of achievement for all peoples and all nations."
The Universal Declaration of Human Rights is a document regarded as a common standard of achievement for all peoples and all nations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as asserting that culture is irrelevant to the validity of moral rules and thus, reaffirms the universality, indivisibility, equality and interdependence of all human rights (Blackburn, 2011: 10)."

Universalism is defined as asserting that culture is irrelevant to the validity of moral rules and thus, reaffirms the universality, indivisibility, equality and interdependence of all human rights (Blackburn, 2011: 10).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Group of individuals of species occupying a definite geographic area at a given time (Deshmukh, ND: 3)."
Population is a Group of individuals of species occupying a definite geographic area at a given time (Deshmukh, ND: 3).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the refugees' right not to be returned to persecution, either in their country of origin or in other countries in which they would be at risk."
Non- refoulement is the refugees' right not to be returned to persecution, either in their country of origin or in other countries in which they would be at risk.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the expression of the general will; all citizens have the right to concur personally, or through their representatives, in its formation; it must be the same for all, whether it protects or punishes."

Law is the expression of the general will; all citizens have the right to concur personally, or through their representatives, in its formation; it must be the same for all, whether it protects or punishes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a key dimension for all development programmes that include an infrastructure component."
Physical accessibility is a key dimension for all development programmes that include an infrastructure component.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the more comprehensive right to control one's own body."
Reproductive rights and freedoms is the more comprehensive right to control one's own body.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of half of government representatives and half of representatives of employers and workers of member States."
The Conference and the Governing Body are composed of half of government representatives and half of representatives of employers and workers of member States.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most widespread and persistent violation of human rights."
Violence against women (VAW) is the most widespread and persistent violation of human rights.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the real wealth of nations, they are central to development."
People are the real wealth of nations, they are central to development.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a concept that is strongly promoted by the United Nations and its various development agencies and programmes as well as by certain donor countries, among them Australia and the United Kingdom."

The (Human) rights-based approach is a concept that is strongly promoted by the United Nations and its various development agencies and programmes as well as by certain donor countries, among them Australia and the United Kingdom.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means more than being an alien."
Being a refugee means more than being an alien.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most fundamental rights of human beings."
Human rights are the most fundamental rights of human beings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fundamental human rights issue and a central challenge to development, democracy and peace (WHO, 2013 quoted in Oxfam, 2014)."
Violence against women and girls is a fundamental human rights issue and a central challenge to development, democracy and peace (WHO, 2013 quoted in Oxfam, 2014).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vehicle to secure this idea in the civil state (Peter, ND: 7)."
The social contract is a vehicle to secure this idea in the civil state (Peter, ND: 7).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the two Major conventions i.e. the 1951 convention and the 1967 protocol."
Major instruments considered are the two Major conventions i.e. the 1951 convention and the 1967 protocol.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the definitive international legal instrument requiring respect for and observance of the human rights of women."
The Women's Convention is the definitive international legal instrument requiring respect for and observance of the human rights of women.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for protecting the fundamental human rights of their citizens."
States are responsible for protecting the fundamental human rights of their citizens.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are concerned with the promotion and protection of human rights: the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE), the Council of Europe (CoE) and the European Union (EU)."

Three European inter-governmental organisations are concerned with the promotion and protection of human rights: the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE), the Council of Europe (CoE) and the European Union (EU).

The State of Nature is the conditions under which men lived prior to the formation of societies, which may be considered as an historical fact or a hypothetical claim (Steele, 1993: 4).
______ means claiming solidarity with all other human beings.
Meeting these responsibilities
Meeting these responsibilities means claiming solidarity with all other human beings.

Right to development

constitution
The constitution is the highest law of the state.

notion of persecution

refugee
